virtual_mashine.screen.title: PC
virtual_mashine.option.name: PC name
virtual_mashine.option.iso.tooltip: ISO file in the CD drive. Put .iso files into the ISO folder or drop them onto this window. Can be swapped while the PC is running.
virtual_mashine.option.disk.created: The disk already exists, its size is fixed.
virtual_mashine.option.boot.tooltip: "Disk first" still boots from the CD as long as the disk has no operating system yet.
virtual_mashine.option.acceleration.tool:
On: fast (hardware virtualization, WHPX on Windows). On Windows the PC cannot be frozen then.
Off: pure emulation – much slower, but the PC can be frozen.
virtual_mashine.button.iso_folder.toolti: Opens the folder for .iso files. Reopen this menu afterwards, or drop the ISO onto the window.
virtual_mashine.button.shutdown.tooltip: Sends the power button signal. The operating system shuts down cleanly by itself.
virtual_mashine.button.power_off.tooltip: Off immediately – like pulling the plug. Unsaved data inside the PC is lost.
virtual_mashine.button.freeze.tooltip: Saves the complete state including RAM and switches off. The next start continues exactly there.
virtual_mashine.button.freeze.unsupporte: With acceleration (WHPX) enabled, QEMU on Windows cannot save the RAM state. Turn acceleration off in the settings to be able to freeze.
virtual_mashine.button.discard.tooltip: Deletes the frozen state. The PC then boots normally (the disk is kept).
virtual_mashine.hint.frozen: Frozen: "Resume" continues exactly where you left off. Hardware is locked until you resume or discard the state.
virtual_mashine.hint.freezable: When you leave the world, the PC is frozen and later continues exactly where it was.
virtual_mashine.hint.not_freezable: When you leave the world, the PC shuts down cleanly (the disk is kept). Turn acceleration off to freeze instead.
virtual_mashine.hint.click_to_capture: Click the screen to use the PC  •  ESC = back (PC keeps running)
virtual_mashine.hint.captured: Left Ctrl + Left Alt = release mouse & keyboard
virtual_mashine.msg.qemu_missing: QEMU was not found. Install QEMU (e.g. "winget install SoftwareFreedomConservancy.QEMU") or set its path in config/virtual_mashine.json.
virtual_mashine.msg.iso_missing: The inserted ISO file was not found, the CD drive is empty.
virtual_mashine.msg.resume_failed: The frozen state could not be loaded. You can discard it and start normally. Details:
virtual_mashine.msg.shutdown_requested: Power button signal sent, the operating system is shutting down.
virtual_mashine.msg.frozen: Frozen. The next start continues right here.
virtual_mashine.msg.freeze_unsupported: Freezing only works with acceleration turned off (WHPX does not support it).
virtual_mashine.hint.ram_low: Warning: only %s of RAM is free right now, but the PC is set to %s. Windows will swap to disk and everything gets extremely slow – lower the RAM or close programs.
virtual_mashine.import.host_only: Only the host can add ISOs (on their computer)
virtual_mashine.button.iso_folder.host_o: The ISO folder is on the host's computer. Only the host can add ISO files there, but you can insert any of the existing ones.
virtual_mashine.cable.usage: Right-click a device: choose a port · Sneak + right-click into the air: colour
virtual_mashine.ports.title: Ports
virtual_mashine.ports.heading: %s – Ports
virtual_mashine.ports.unpowered: Powered off – the ports have no link
virtual_mashine.ports.tip.half: Cable plugged in – you hold the other end
virtual_mashine.ports.status.pending: One end is plugged into %s – now click the second device and pick a port there.
virtual_mashine.ports.status.choose: Pick a free port for the cable.
virtual_mashine.ports.status.no_cable: Hold a cable to connect something. Click a used port to unplug it.
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.no_cable: You are not holding a cable.
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.occupied: This port is already in use.
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.first_end: First end plugged in – now walk to the second device.
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.other_dimensio: The cable does not reach into another dimension.
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.too_long: Too far away – the cable is at most 100 m long.
virtual_mashine.option.network.cable.too: The network cards sit behind the device's ports. Connect them with cables to a switch, router or internet uplink.
virtual_mashine.option.network.direct.to: Shortcut without cables: one network card with built-in internet (NAT).
virtual_mashine.button.ports.tooltip: Shows this device's network ports (plug and unplug cables).
virtual_mashine.option.autostart.tooltip: Starts together with the world – for servers, routers and switches that should always run.
virtual_mashine.option.nic.tooltip: Model of the virtual network card. e1000 works everywhere; virtio-net is fastest (Linux, router systems), Windows needs drivers for it.
item.virtual_mashine.network_tester.desc: Right-click a device: ports with speed, MAC address and traffic
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.needs_console_: Only a console cable fits the console socket.
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.needs_network_: A console cable belongs in COM1 or Console, not in a network port.
virtual_mashine.option.image.tooltip: A ready-made system instead of installing from an ISO: disk images (.img, .img.gz, .qcow2, .vmdk, .vdi, .vhdx) from the ISO folder are copied onto the disk at the first start.
Downloads the current OpenWrt release (real router software, about 14 MB) and sets it up at the first start: as a router (eth0/eth2/eth3 = LAN, eth1 = WAN) or as a managed switch (all ports bridged). Configure it afterwards through its web interface (LuCI) or the console.
virtual_mashine.button.reset_disk.toolti: Erases this device's disk. The next start begins from scratch (with the selected image).
virtual_mashine.reset_disk.title: Erase the disk?
virtual_mashine.reset_disk.message: Everything on the disk of %s will be lost. This cannot be undone.
virtual_mashine.msg.provisioning: Setting up OpenWrt on its first start…
virtual_mashine.msg.importing: Copying the image onto the disk:
virtual_mashine.msg.openwrt_needs_empty_: OpenWrt needs an empty disk. Erase it first (the device must be off).
virtual_mashine.msg.openwrt_ready: Ready – installs at the next start:
virtual_mashine.ports.msg.wireless: The WLAN card has no socket – connect it in the laptop's WLAN menu.
virtual_mashine.wlan.title: WLAN
virtual_mashine.wlan.heading: %s – WLAN
virtual_mashine.wlan.msg.not_found: This network does not exist (any more).
virtual_mashine.wlan.msg.saved_offline: Saved – connects as soon as the network is in range.
virtual_mashine.wlan.msg.bad_password: The WPA2 password needs 8–63 characters (empty = open WLAN).
virtual_mashine.wlan.msg.saved: Saved. Connected devices log in again.
virtual_mashine.ap.title: Access Point
virtual_mashine.ap.heading: %s – WLAN settings
virtual_mashine.ap.hint: Sneak + right-click: LAN port · Stone weakens the signal a lot, glass hardly
virtual_mashine.ap.no_clients: None yet – connect from a laptop's WLAN menu.
virtual_mashine.button.paste.tooltip: Types the text from your clipboard into the PC – works with every operating system, consoles included. When spice-vdagent runs in the PC (most Linux desktops ship it), normal copy and paste works in both directions as well.
virtual_mashine.button.layout.tooltip: Keyboard layout set in the PC's operating system (DE or US). The Paste button types with it, so it has to match the PC's setting.
virtual_mashine.msg.paste_skipped: %s characters do not exist on this keyboard and were skipped.
virtual_mashine.option.clipboard.tooltip: Share the clipboard with the PC (needs spice-vdagent in the PC). Your text only goes to the PC when you click into its screen. Turn it off for malware tests to keep the PC fully apart. The device for it is added or removed on the next start.
item.virtual_mashine.phone.wlan: Internet only via WLAN – stay within reach of an access point
Downloads Android-x86 9 (open source, about 920 MB, checksum verified) and installs it automatically on the next start. Afterwards it is a normal Android: install apps as APK or through e.g. F-Droid.
virtual_mashine.msg.android_needs_empty_: Android can only go onto an empty disk. Erase it first (the phone must be off).
virtual_mashine.msg.android_ready: Android is ready – it is installed on the next start (takes a few minutes).
virtual_mashine.msg.android_installing: Installing Android – the phone restarts by itself afterwards. A few minutes of patience …
virtual_mashine.io.title: I/O Module
virtual_mashine.io.mode.tooltip: Input: reads the redstone level arriving at exactly this face (0–15). Output: drives the set level on this face only – e.g. for a piston.
virtual_mashine.io.name: Name
virtual_mashine.io.no_link: No network cable (or the other end is off) · MAC %s
virtual_mashine.io.no_address: Waiting for an address by DHCP … · MAC %s
virtual_mashine.io.help: Modbus TCP: %1$s port 502 · Web and JSON: http://%1$s/
virtual_mashine.io.help.noip: Modbus TCP port 502 · web page and JSON API on port 80
virtual_mashine.display.apply.tooltip: Saves page and size and (re)starts the display with them.
virtual_mashine.display.window.tooltip: Open the picture in a window – the keyboard works there too.
virtual_mashine.display.hint: In the world: look at it, click, drag, scroll · sneak = Minecraft
